handoff_note: Compact handoff: paired change lists reduced to counts; full diagnostics and exact case IDs remain in bound external report.
limitations: Six correlated synthetic development question families; expectations are not independent human calibration.
Two repeats provide limited repeatability evidence; no determinism claim.
Inventory marker and quote compliance is heuristic, not validation of essentiality or candidate independence.
Rationale length changes with inventory; compare output tokens and latency alongside scores.
Native-token cost estimates are not billing statements.
next_step: Stop for user review; no automatic promotion or further experiments.
